key.name: refresh-seconds
key.summary: Transcript refresh interval (seconds)
key.description: How often local ~/.claude transcripts and ~/.codex session logs are re-parsed for tokens and cost.

key.name: usage-refresh-seconds
key.summary: Usage API refresh interval (seconds)
key.description: How often the subscription usage endpoint is polled. It rate-limits aggressive polling, so values below ~120s are not recommended.

key.name: show-icon
key.summary: Show the provider icon on each panel button

key.name: icon-color
key.summary: Panel icon color
key.description: white: monochrome white; orange: original brand terracotta; accent: follow the accent-color setting.

key.name: show-panel-text
key.summary: Show text next to the panel icon

key.name: panel-format
key.summary: What the panel text shows
key.description: five-week: 5h% and week%; five: 5h% only; week: week% only; cost: today's cost; five-week-cost: all three.

key.name: status-loading
key.summary: Text shown while waiting for usage data

key.name: status-error
key.summary: Text shown when usage data can't be fetched

key.name: status-throttled
key.summary: Text shown in the menu header when the usage API is rate-limited

key.name: show-usage-section
key.summary: Show subscription usage bars (5h / week)

key.name: show-model-usage-bars
key.summary: Show per-model weekly usage bars (Opus / Sonnet)

key.name: show-today-section
key.summary: Show today's tokens section

key.name: show-model-breakdown
key.summary: Show per-model token breakdown for today

key.name: show-token-details
key.summary: Show input / cache token totals

key.name: show-cost
key.summary: Show estimated API-equivalent cost

key.name: show-projects-section
key.summary: Show tokens grouped by project for the selected period

key.name: projects-max
key.summary: Maximum number of projects listed

key.name: period
key.summary: Time period for the summary, model-share graph and projects
key.description: Switched from the header D/W/M/Y/A button.

key.name: show-graph-cost
key.summary: Show the daily token usage graph

key.name: cost-history-days
key.summary: Days of token history to show (0 = all time)

key.name: token-metric
key.summary: Which tokens the daily graph counts
key.description: all: input+output+cache; no-cache: input+output; output: output only.

key.name: show-graph-util
key.summary: Show the utilization trend graph

key.name: util-trend-days
key.summary: Days of utilization trend to display (0 = all time; all samples are retained on disk)

key.name: show-graph-models
key.summary: Show the per-model token-share graph

key.name: section-order
key.summary: Order in which dropdown blocks are shown

key.name: bar-width
key.summary: Progress bar / graph width (px)

key.name: accent-color
key.summary: Accent color for bars and graphs
key.description: Any CSS color string, e.g. #D97757 or rgb(217,119,87).

key.name: pricing
key.summary: Custom pricing override (JSON)
key.description: JSON array of [model-substring, input $/MTok, output $/MTok, cached input $/MTok (optional)]. Empty string uses the built-in defaults. Shared by both buttons: only the Claude schema's value is read.

key.name: hidden-families
key.summary: Model families hidden from the dropdown list
